ghi_chu.mo_ta: The ensign on the stern of the right-hand ship is a red-white-red horizontal tricolour. It resembles an Austrian-style flag, not a Spanish, British or French naval ensign.
ghi_chu.ly_do: A red-white-red ensign does not match any naval ensign used at Gibraltar in 1779. The Spanish navy flew a white ensign with the royal arms, and the red-yellow-red Spanish flag only came in 1785. The design looks anachronistic or invented.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: A small flag on a pole on the central camp field is white with a red cross and saltire, like a Union Jack. It is very small and blurred.
ghi_chu.ly_do: If it is the Union flag with the St Patrick's saltire, that design dates from 1801. The 1606 Union flag would be correct for 1779. I can't tell which it is.
